title: Energy Double Jump
description: Unlimited double jump with energy bar
body:
# DoubleJump
A Paper/Spigot plugin for Minecraft 1.21+ that lets players perform unlimited **Double Press Space** double jumps with an energy bar.

## ✨ Features
- Unlimited double jumps
- Energy bar with 100 points
- Each jump costs 10 energy
- Regenerates 5 energy every 2s
- On 0 energy: shows "Energy Low" title

## 📥 Installation
1. Download the latest release from Modrinth.
2. Place the JAR in your `plugins/` folder.
3. Restart the server.

## ⚙️ Configuration (optional)
Future versions may allow config.yml for tuning energy costs/regeneration.
